note: Reviewed LABEL vocabulary for the rendered claim-ledger views, and nothing else. Claim bodies, falsifier text, correction reasons and every superseded text are quoted from evidence/claims.json in the source language and are never translated -- tools/ci/check_claims.py refuses two views whose quotations differ. The Arabic labels here are scaffolding: no Arabic-reading reviewer has read them, which is what CL-011 records as unknown rather than asserting a localized pack a supervisor could act on.
